newsitem.title: USA: Kapson sells $50mln of convertible pfd shrs.
newsitem.headline: Kapson sells $50mln of convertible pfd shrs.

text.p: Kapson Senior Quarters Corp said Wednesday it will sell 2.0 million shares of convertible exchangeable preferred stock at $25 per share.

The offering is expected to close on July 3. The shares are non-callable for three years, convertible into common stock at $12.98 per share, and pay an annual dividend of $2 per share. Kapson traded at $11 per share Wednesday afternoon.
The company said it will use the proceeds to develop more assisted living facilities and repay debt.

Kapson also has the option to swap, in whole or in part, the preferred stock for eight percent convertible notes due 2007 at the rate of $1,000 principal amount of notes for each 40 shares of preferred stock.
